title: add jsonschema response_format + strict validation mode
author: Nina Patel
release_notes: Add support for response_format=json_schema with optional strict validation mode (response_format.strict=true). Improves schema validation errors and OpenAI-compatible response hints. Backwards compatible by default; strict mode can be enabled per-request.
description:
Motivation: customers want first-class structured output guarantees (JSON Schema) from the API while maintaining streaming and OpenAI-compat behavior. This PR adds a new response_format type `json_schema` and a `strict` sub-flag that enforces returned JSON strictly conforming to the provided schema. When strict=false (default), we attempt best-effort schema-conforming output and emit detailed schema warnings in response metadata.

What changed: 1) API surface: `response_format` extended to accept {type: "json_schema", schema: <JSONSchema>, strict: boolean}. The SDKs (Python/TS) pick up the parameter and forward it to the API in a backwards-compatible way. 2) Runtime validation: a streaming-aware validator is introduced that performs incremental parse/validation and can produce deterministic validation errors if strict=true. 3) OpenAI compatibility: the openai-compat shim recognizes `response_format` and maps it to function-calling / json_schema hints to preserve semantics for existing clients. 4) Error messages: unified validation error payloads (code + message + path) are surfaced in the response envelope and in the Console logs for easier debugging. 5) Tests & docs: unit + e2e tests for streaming/strict interactions and updated docs with examples and migration notes.

Design notes: - Streaming + strict mode: strict mode requires the entire JSON to validate; for streaming we buffer decoded tokens until a top-level JSON object/array completes, then validate and either emit the validated JSON or emit a structured validation error. To avoid large memory pressure we limit buffered size and fall back to non-strict mode with a clear warning if the schema-produced response exceeds the buffer threshold. - Best-effort mode: when strict=false we run lightweight incremental validation to provide hints/warnings progressively but do not fail the request; this keeps low-latency streaming UX. - OpenAI-compat: we translate JSON Schema into function-like hints when clients are using function-calling so that models that understand OpenAI function hints will still prefer schema-compliant generations.

Files changed (high-level): listed below. Small implementation snippets included in runtime validator and the compatibility shim.

Testing: added unit tests for the validator, integration tests exercising streaming strict=true, and compatibility checks against the shim. CI passing locally and on CI after an initial lint failure fixed in a follow-up commit.

Risks & mitigations: - Memory risk during strict streaming mode: mitigated by buffer_limit config and fallback path. - Model mismatch producing garbled JSON: improved error messages and dev-friendly console links to failing prompt and trace.

review_comments: Marco Ruiz: This looks great overall. Two questions: 1) can you add a feature flag to roll out strict mode gradually? 2) how do we ensure the buffer limit is configurable per-customer?
Nina Patel: Added feature flag `enable_jsonschema_strict` in defaults and a per-tenant config override. Documented in config/defaults.yaml and the Private installer notes.
Leah Thompson: CI failed on lint in the first run, thanks for fixing. Please add a small e2e for a large valid JSON to hit the buffer fallback path.
Nina Patel: Added integration test `test_streaming_strict_mode` that includes a large payload case to exercise the fallback. Also added telemetry counters for buffer fallback events.
Soren Jacobs: For OpenAI-compat, please confirm we do not change existing function-calling semantics for clients that are already using function hints.

Nina Patel: Confirmed—shim only adds hints when `response_format.type == "json_schema"` and will not alter requests that already have explicit function-calling directives. Added a unit test to assert no-op behavior when function schema present.
